title: Gate shape on a field-isomorphic, founder-issued discovery record
description: First slice of the discovery-gate campaign, re-scoped after independent review. Repairs LB-25-PLN-TRACE-VALIDITY by making the gate value-binding and provenance-validated (an agent cannot self-assert as founder), and LB-25-PLN-CUTOVER-POLICY by pinning one immutable cohort model. Shape cannot reach proceed until every required shape field equals an answer that provably originated from the founder via a durable attestation primitive. Depends on LB-21 provenance.

behaviors.title: Shape proceed is refused without a complete discovery record
behaviors.trigger: A shape with disposition proceed is recorded for a post-cutover issue that has no discovery answer for one or more required shape fields
behaviors.expected: The shape gate refuses proceed with a missing_discovery blocker that names each field lacking an answer, and the issue does not become shape-ready
behaviors.verify: Through the real CLI and MCP surfaces against a disposable database, attempt a proceed shape on a fresh issue with no answers and observe missing_discovery naming the fields, then supply valid founder-issued answers for all fields and observe the shape reach ready

behaviors.title: Each shape field must canonically EQUAL its attested answer, scalar or structured
behaviors.trigger: A discovery answer exists for a required shape field but the recorded shape value is not canonically equal to that answer, for a scalar field or for a structured field (non_goals array, risks array-of-objects)
behaviors.expected: The shape gate refuses proceed with an unbacked_field blocker naming that field. Comparison is deterministic: scalar fields use exact string equality after trimming outer whitespace; non_goals and risks are compared as order-insensitive multisets over their trimmed elements (risks as trimmed {risk,mitigation} pairs), so a reordering is equal but any changed element is not
behaviors.verify: Against a disposable database, for a scalar field diverge the shape value and assert unbacked_field, then align and assert proceed; AND for a structured field (non_goals or risks) assert that a reordered value is accepted as canonically equal while a changed element is refused by name

behaviors.title: Only a founder-issued attestation counts; agent self-assertion is refused
behaviors.trigger: A discovery answer is submitted whose origin is an agent ingress (mcp or cli) or whose attester is a caller-supplied string without a valid capability token
behaviors.expected: The answer is rejected as unattested; the gate accepts an answer only when its origin is validated as founder-issued via the durable attestation primitive (a valid one-time token and a non-agent ingress per LB-21 provenance)
behaviors.verify: Attempt to record a discovery answer through the agent mcp/cli ingress and via a caller-supplied attester without a token and observe rejection, then submit the same answer through the founder attestation round-trip with a valid token and observe acceptance

behaviors.title: The attestation primitive parks until the founder answers out-of-band
behaviors.trigger: A discovery request is opened for a field
behaviors.expected: The request is durable and pending until the founder answers through the out-of-band channel; the delivered answer is stored with its origin and time and is retrievable, and the in-session agent cannot satisfy the request from its own ingress
behaviors.verify: Open a discovery request against a disposable database, confirm it is pending and unsatisfiable from the agent ingress, deliver a founder answer with a valid token through the out-of-band channel, and read the durable answer with origin and timestamp back from the substrate

behaviors.title: Grandfather cohort is stamped at creation and never reclassified
behaviors.trigger: The gate evaluates an issue, and separately the gate is disabled and re-enabled
behaviors.expected: An issue's cohort (pre_gate or gated) is stamped immutably when the issue is created relative to the cutover and never changes; disabling or re-enabling the gate does not reclassify any issue; a pre_gate issue's existing shape is unaffected while a gated issue is subject to the gate
behaviors.verify: Against a disposable database seeded with a pre-cutover issue and a post-cutover issue, assert the pre_gate one is unaffected and the gated one is held, then toggle the gate switch off and on and assert no issue's cohort changed

behaviors.title: The visualizer surfaces the discovery gate
behaviors.trigger: The visualizer renders an issue whose shape is held for missing, mismatched, or unattested discovery answers
behaviors.expected: A discovery gate node shows, per required shape field, whether it is answered, value-matched, and founder-attested
behaviors.verify: Render the graph for a discovery-held issue and observe the discovery node listing each field's answered/matched/attested state

planning.outcome: A shape cannot reach proceed unless every required shape field equals an answer that provably originated from the founder, closing the premise-injection hole at the top of the pipeline in a way an in-session agent cannot forge.
planning.appetite: One coherent slice: a durable founder attestation primitive, a value-binding field-isomorphic gate check in the existing shape path, an immutable cutover cohort, and read-model exposure.
non_goals: Initiative and epic level scoping, which depends on LB-23 tiers (later slice)
Multi-party attestation; founder-only in this slice
The relentless interview experience itself; this slice is the gate and the attestation primitive, not the interview UX
Cryptographic hardening beyond a one-time token plus LB-21 ingress cross-check (named residual risk)

work_units.title: Add the durable founder attestation primitive with provenance validation
work_units.done_when: A discovery request parks until answered out-of-band with a valid one-time token, the answer's founder origin is validated against LB-21 ingress provenance, and an agent-ingress or tokenless answer is refused

work_units.title: Value-binding field-isomorphic gate on shape proceed with an immutable cohort
work_units.done_when: Proceed is refused with named fields until every required shape field equals a founder-attested answer, and cohort classification is immutable across gate toggles Structured fields (non_goals, risks) compare by order-insensitive canonical form.

work_units.title: Surface the discovery gate in the visualizer
work_units.done_when: A discovery-held issue shows each field's answered, matched, and attested state

proofs.method: Attempt proceed with no answers through CLI and MCP, observe missing_discovery naming fields, supply valid founder answers, observe ready.

Exercise BOTH a scalar field (diverge then align) AND a structured field (non_goals or risks): assert a reordered structured value is accepted as canonically equal and a changed element is refused, so the proof cannot pass on scalar fields alone.
Submit an answer via the agent ingress and via a tokenless caller-supplied attester and assert rejection, then via the founder round-trip with a valid token and assert acceptance.
Open a request, confirm it is pending and unsatisfiable from the agent ingress, deliver a founder answer out-of-band with a valid token, read the durable answer with origin and timestamp.
Seed a pre-cutover and a post-cutover issue, assert exempt vs held, toggle the gate off and on, assert no cohort changed.

planning.production_wiring: New discovery table in db.ts migrate() keyed by (issue_id, field_key) with answer, attested_by, attested_at, and origin (the LB-21 trigger_type of the ingress that wrote it); plus an immutable gate_cohort marker stamped on issues at creation relative to a recorded discovery cutover. A durable attestation primitive: discovery_request (agent-callable via MCP/CLI) opens a pending ask and issues a one-time capability token delivered out-of-band through the served web UI (loopbreaker serve) or the founder terminal, never returned on the agent ingress; discovery_respond accepts an answer only with a valid unused token AND a non-agent origin per LB-21 provenance, and marks the ask answered. shapeState/recordShape in src/domain.ts gain the gate: a proceed disposition requires, for every required shape field, a discovery row whose answer is canonically equal to the shape value and whose origin is founder-validated, else a missing_discovery / unbacked_field / unattested_field blocker naming the field, unless the issue's cohort is pre_gate. A default-on LOOPBREAKER_DISCOVERY_GATE switch disables the requirement without reclassifying cohorts. substrate() exposes per-field answered/matched/attested state and web/src/graph.ts renders the discovery node. Depends on LB-21 provenance ingress stamping. Value equality is one deterministic comparator per field type: scalar fields (problem, appetite, smallest_slice, success_signal, reversibility, decision_owner) use exact string equality after trimming outer whitespace; non_goals is an order-insensitive multiset of its trimmed string elements; risks is an order-insensitive multiset of its trimmed {risk,mitigation} pairs. Both the discovery answer and the shape value are normalized to this canonical form before comparison, so reordering is equal and any changed element is not.
planning.rollback: Set LOOPBREAKER_DISCOVERY_GATE=off. The shape gate then behaves exactly as today, the discovery and attestation tables are inert, and no issue's immutable cohort is changed. No data loss.
planning.migration: Additive tables and an immutable gate_cohort marker. Issues that exist before the recorded cutover are stamped pre_gate and grandfathered; issues created after are stamped gated. The stamp is written once at classification and never recomputed, so toggling the gate cannot reclassify a cohort.

risks.risk: An in-session agent that exfiltrates the one-time token could forge a founder answer.
risks.mitigation: Token delivered outside the agent session plus an LB-21 ingress cross-check that refuses agent origins; deeper hardening is a named non-goal.

risks.risk: Hard dependency on LB-21 provenance stamping.
risks.mitigation: LB-21 is planned and admitted; this slice names it a prerequisite and the origin check is the reason provenance was worth building.

risks.risk: Grandfathering leaves a mix of gated and pre_gate shapes.
risks.mitigation: The cohort is stamped and exposed per issue, so the mix is explicit rather than silent.
